text: I have used this app for ~8 years, tried others at times but have always come back to this one. I use it every day. It has a clear overview and great, relevant functions that actually, truly helps you get (or stay) on track.

text: Limited by the author's sententiousness; "don't think in terms of breaking bad habits but rephrase it as forming good habits of avoiding bad things". Well, I want to indulge in for example beer, but I'd like to avoid having too many each week. How exactly do you phrase that as a good habit? I don't need to have so or so many "beer free" days per week, or "less than X beer" days, I just want to track that I don't have too many beers *in total* in a week. Which the app won't let me. So, just 2 ★.
